'''Zherriak''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from<ref name="DNH" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. For a long [[Time/Legends|time]], they lived a peaceful life, maintaining a close friendship with their [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] partner, the Wookiee [[Liak]], with whom they had sworn an honor bond.<ref name="DNH" /> At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Zherriak was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] [[Imperial enslavement raid|raid]]. Afterward, Liak and several other Wookiees managed to overpower the Imperials and [[Thief/Legends|steal]] their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to escape their captors. While many of the surviving Wookiees returned to Kashyyyk after the raid, Liak, bent on avenging his friend, instead turned to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and offered his services to them.<ref name="DNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zherriak was mentioned in the short story "[[Do No Harm]]" by [[Erin Endom]], which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|tenth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' in [[May]] [[1996]].<ref name="DNH" />
